ATLAS SAFETY GATE

This is a dry-run starter, not connected to Shopify. It uses synthetic sample records only.

Before production: add read-only Shopify retrieval, confirm supplier/POD SKU mapping, reconcile locations, add deduplication + audit logging, test error paths, then review output. Do not enable inventory writes or continue-selling settings automatically.
